evidence: Carries the Wallet label, touches CWallet::FillPSBT, descriptor handling, and scriptpubkeyman to populate PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB.
rationale: Populating PSBT_GLOBAL_XPUB fixes interoperability failures with stateless hardware signers and resolves long-standing downstream workarounds. BitBox02 devices currently reject signing 2-of-3 multisig PSBTs produced by Bitcoin Core without this field, and coordinators like Specter Desktop maintain dedicated workarounds (closing issue #27583).
